def seeded(tmp_path, *, chars=1500):
    store, manager, _model, worker = prepared(tmp_path, [])
    token = manager._claim(worker["id"])
    originals = {}
    with store.unit_of_work() as work:
        for ordinal in range(2, 10):
            message = {
                "role": "assistant",
                "content": f"original-{ordinal}:"
                + "x" * (chars if ordinal < 8 else 10)
                + "中文\r\n",
            }
            originals[ordinal] = message
            work.connection.execute(
                "INSERT INTO worker_messages VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                (worker["id"], ordinal, message["role"], _json(message)),
            )
    return store, manager, worker, token, originals


def archives(store):
    with store.connection() as connection:
        return [tuple(row) for row in connection.execute("SELECT * FROM context_archives")]


def test_worker_batches_use_complete_previous_handoff_and_immutable_sources(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("FORGE_ENFORCE_TOKEN_BUDGETS", "false")
    store, manager, worker, token, originals = seeded(tmp_path)
    summaries, selected = [], []

    def handler(request):
        body = json.loads(request.content)
        assert not body.get("tools") and not body.get("response_format")
        assert len(json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=False).encode()) + 64 + 128 <= 7000
        packet = json.loads(body["messages"][1]["content"])
        assert packet["previous_context"] == (summaries[-1] if summaries else {})
        for item in packet["messages"]:
            assert item["message"] == originals[item["ordinal"]]
            selected.append(item["ordinal"])
        summaries.append(f"Handoff {len(summaries) + 1}: preserve original analysis and next step.")
        return http_response(summaries[-1])

    gateway = mock_gateway(store, handler)
    manager.providers = ProviderPool({"protocol": gateway})
    compactor = WorkerModelCompactor(
        manager, gateway, worker["id"], token, context_limit=7000, output_limit=128
    )
    while True:
        result = asyncio.run(compactor.compact(input_budget=6000, source_readback_available=True))
        if not result["source_count"]:
            break
    assert len(summaries) >= 2 and selected == sorted(set(selected))
    assert selected[0] == 2 and selected[-1] <= 7
    service = ContextService(store)
    for ordinal in selected:
        assert (
            json.loads(service.read_source("worker", worker["id"], ordinal)["message_json"])
            == originals[ordinal]
        )
    context = service.build_worker_context(worker["id"], input_budget=6000)
    capsule = json.loads(
        next(
            item["content"] for item in context if item["content"].startswith("Archived task")
        ).split(": ", 1)[1]
    )
    assert capsule["model_handoff"]["text"] == summaries[-1]
    assert capsule["model_handoff"]["status"] == "unverified"
    assert capsule["task"]["task_node_key"] == "n"
    assert manager.get(worker["id"])["steps"] == len(summaries)
    assert manager.get(worker["id"])["token_spent"] == 40 * len(summaries)
    with store.connection() as c:
        local = c.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_model_reservations").fetchall()
        attempts = c.execute("SELECT * FROM model_budget_attempts").fetchall()
        assert len(local) == len(attempts) == len(summaries)
        assert all(
            row["state"] == "settled"
            and json.loads(row["context_json"])["purpose"] == "context_compaction"
            for row in local
        )
        assert all(
            row["purpose"] == "context_compaction" and row["worker_run_id"] == worker["id"]
            for row in attempts
        )
        assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM evidence").fetchone()[0] == 0
    with store.unit_of_work() as work:
        work.connection.execute(
            "UPDATE worker_messages SET message_json='{}' WHERE run_id=? AND ordinal=2",
            (worker["id"],),
        )
    with pytest.raises(DomainError, match="integrity"):
        service.build_worker_context(worker["id"], input_budget=6000)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("race", ["expired", "new_owner", "paused", "plan", "capsule", "message"])
def test_worker_model_handoff_cannot_checkpoint_after_fence_or_frontier_changes(
    tmp_path, race, monkeypatch
):
    monkeypatch.setenv("FORGE_ENFORCE_TOKEN_BUDGETS", "false")
    store, manager, worker, token, _originals = seeded(tmp_path)
    before = archives(store)

    def handler(_request):
        with store.unit_of_work() as work:
            if race == "expired":
                work.connection.execute(
                    "UPDATE worker_runs SET lease_until=0 WHERE id=?", (worker["id"],)
                )
            elif race == "new_owner":
                work.connection.execute(
                    "UPDATE worker_runs SET lease_token='REDACTED',generation=generation+1 WHERE id=?",
                    (worker["id"],),
                )
            elif race == "paused":
                work.connection.execute(
                    "UPDATE quests SET status='paused' WHERE id=?", (worker["quest_id"],)
                )
            elif race == "plan":
                work.connection.execute(
                    "UPDATE quest_plans SET status='superseded' WHERE id=?", (worker["plan_id"],)
                )
            elif race == "capsule":
                work.connection.execute(
                    "UPDATE worker_capsules SET revision=revision+1,next_action='changed' WHERE run_id=?",
                    (worker["id"],),
                )
            else:
                work.connection.execute(
                    "UPDATE worker_messages SET message_json=? WHERE run_id=? AND ordinal=2",
                    (_json({"role": "assistant", "content": "changed"}), worker["id"]),
                )
        return http_response()

    gateway = mock_gateway(store, handler)
    with pytest.raises(DomainError):
        asyncio.run(
            WorkerModelCompactor(
                manager, gateway, worker["id"], token, context_limit=9000, output_limit=128
            ).compact(input_budget=6000, source_readback_available=True)
        )
    assert archives(store) == before
    with store.connection() as c:
        # Received usage is settled even when it grants no checkpoint authority.
        assert c.execute("SELECT state FROM model_budget_attempts").fetchone()[0] == "settled"
        assert c.execute("SELECT state FROM worker_model_reservations").fetchone()[0] == "settled"
    assert manager.get(worker["id"])["token_spent"] == 40

            self.kind not in {"openai_compatible", "deepseek"}

            or self.reasoning_effort

def default_workspace_root() -> Path:
    if os.name == "nt":
        base = Path(os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", str(Path.home() / "AppData" / "Local")))
        return base / "FORGE" / "workspaces" / "default"
    if sys.platform == "darwin":
        return Path.home() / "Library" / "Application Support" / "FORGE" / "workspaces" / "default"
    base = Path(os.environ.get("XDG_DATA_HOME", str(Path.home() / ".local" / "share")))

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Workspace:
    id: str
    root: Path

    def __post_init__(self):
        path = Path(self.root).expanduser()
        if not path.is_absolute():
            raise ValueError("Workspace root must be an absolute path")
        if not self.id.strip():
            raise ValueError("FORGE_WORKSPACE_ID must not be empty")
        object.__setattr__(self, "root", path.resolve())

    @classmethod
    def from_path(cls, root: str | Path, workspace_id: str | None = None):
        path = Path(root).expanduser()
        if not path.is_absolute():
            raise ValueError("Workspace root must be an absolute path")
        path = path.resolve()
        identity = (
            workspace_id
            if workspace_id is not None
            else hashlib.sha256(os.path.normcase(str(path)).encode()).hexdigest()[:24]
        )
        return cls(id=identity, root=path)

    def resolve(self, path: str | Path) -> Path:
        candidate = Path(path).expanduser()
        return (candidate if candidate.is_absolute() else self.root / candidate).resolve()

"""Offline context/receipt fixtures and Mock HTTP; no real Provider evidence."""

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json

import pytest
from test_model_compaction_v29 import http_response, mock_gateway
from test_worker_context_tail_phase2 import oversized_tail
from test_worker_intelligence_phase2 import delivery, prepared, response
from test_worker_model_compaction_v29 import seeded

from forge_core.context_service import ContextService, _hash, _json, _worker_handoff_input
from forge_core.domain import DomainError
from forge_core.store import Store
from forge_core.worker_model_compaction import WorkerModelCompactor

pytest_plugins = ["test_worker_runtime"]


def prior_handoff_with_settled_tail(graph):
    store, run, _ = oversized_tail(graph)
    service = ContextService(store)
    selected = service._worker_context(
        run["id"], input_budget=6000, source_readback_available=True, _prepare=True
    )
    service._worker_context(
        run["id"], input_budget=6000, source_readback_available=True,
        _expected=selected["snapshot"],
        _handoff={"text": "Earlier analysis. " * 85,
                  "input_digest": _hash(_worker_handoff_input(selected, selected["selected"]))},
        _max_sources=len(selected["selected"]),
    )
    with store.unit_of_work() as work:
        c = work.connection
        # Synthetic settled receipt fixtures, each with a unique call identity.
        intent = dict(c.execute("SELECT * FROM action_intents WHERE id='intent-1'").fetchone())
        intent.update(id="intent-later", call_id="call-later")
        c.execute("INSERT INTO action_intents VALUES (" + ",".join("?" for _ in intent) + ")", tuple(intent.values()))
        output = {"content": "settled response " * 155}
        result = _json(output)
        c.execute("INSERT INTO action_receipts VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)", (
            "receipt-later", "intent-later", "mock", result,
            hashlib.sha256(result.encode()).hexdigest(), "now"))
        c.execute("INSERT INTO worker_tool_calls VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", (
            run["id"], "call-later", "model-later", "read", intent["parameters_json"],
            "succeeded", "receipt-later", result))
        messages = [
            {"role": "assistant", "content": "Old delivery. " * 350},
            {"role": "user", "content": "Revise with the existing source."},
            {"role": "assistant", "content": "", "tool_calls": [{
                "id": "model-later", "type": "function", "function": {
                    "name": "read", "arguments": intent["parameters_json"]}}]},
            {"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": "model-later", "content": result},
        ]
        start = c.execute("SELECT max(ordinal)+1 FROM worker_messages WHERE run_id=?", (run["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
        for ordinal, message in enumerate(messages, start):
            c.execute("INSERT INTO worker_messages VALUES (?,?,?,?)", (
                run["id"], ordinal, message["role"], _json(message)))
    return store, run, list(range(start, start + len(messages)))


def test_existing_handoff_is_counted_before_whole_settled_tail_selection(graph):
    store, run, tail = prior_handoff_with_settled_tail(graph)
    service = ContextService(store)
    with store.connection() as c:
        before = c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM context_archives").fetchone()[0]
    result = service._worker_context(
        run["id"], input_budget=6000, source_readback_available=True, _prepare=True
    )
    assert [row["ordinal"] for row in result["selected"]] == tail
    with store.connection() as c:
        assert c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM context_archives").fetchone()[0] == before


@pytest.mark.parametrize("unsafe", ["pending", "uncertain", "missing_receipt"])
def test_handoff_fallback_keeps_unsettled_or_unreceipted_tail_live(graph, unsafe):
    store, run, _ = prior_handoff_with_settled_tail(graph)
    with store.unit_of_work() as work:
        if unsafe == "pending":
            work.connection.execute("UPDATE worker_tool_calls SET state='pending' WHERE call_id='call-later'")
        elif unsafe == "uncertain":
            work.connection.execute("UPDATE action_intents SET state='uncertain' WHERE id='intent-later'")
        else:
            work.connection.execute("UPDATE worker_tool_calls SET receipt_id=NULL WHERE call_id='call-later'")
    with pytest.raises(DomainError, match="context budget"):
        ContextService(store)._worker_context(
            run["id"], input_budget=6000, source_readback_available=True, _prepare=True
        )


def test_registry_capacity_does_not_become_a_cumulative_execution_grant(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    save_model = Store.save_model

    def operator_profile(self, profile):
        return save_model(self, profile.model_copy(update={"context_window": 100000000}))

    monkeypatch.setattr(Store, "save_model", operator_profile)
    monkeypatch.setenv("FORGE_ENFORCE_TOKEN_BUDGETS", "true")
    store, manager, model, worker = prepared(tmp_path, [response(delivery())])
    seen = []
    original = ContextService.build_worker_context

    def observe(self, run_id, **kwargs):
        seen.append(kwargs["input_budget"])
        return original(self, run_id, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(ContextService, "build_worker_context", observe)
    outcome = asyncio.run(manager.run(worker["id"]))
    assert outcome["state"] == "review_pending"
    assert model.requests[0].context_limit == 100000000
    assert 0 < seen[0] < worker["token_limit"] < 100000000
    assert outcome["token_limit"] == worker["token_limit"]
    assert outcome["token_spent"] == 40
    with store.connection() as c:
        reservation = c.execute("SELECT reserved_tokens FROM worker_model_reservations").fetchone()[0]
    assert reservation <= worker["token_limit"]


def test_compactor_selects_an_affordable_whole_prefix_without_widening_budget(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("FORGE_ENFORCE_TOKEN_BUDGETS", "true")
    store, manager, worker, token, _ = seeded(tmp_path, chars=4000)
    seen = []

    def handler(request):
        body = json.loads(request.content)
        packet = json.loads(body["messages"][1]["content"])
        seen.extend(item["ordinal"] for item in packet["messages"])
        return http_response("Retain the source references and finish the original task.")

    gateway = mock_gateway(store, handler)
    result = asyncio.run(WorkerModelCompactor(
        manager, gateway, worker["id"], token, context_limit=64000, output_limit=128
    ).compact(input_budget=6000, source_readback_available=True))
    assert result["source_count"] and seen[0] == 2
    assert seen[-1] < 7
    assert manager.get(worker["id"])["token_limit"] == worker["token_limit"]
    with store.connection() as c:
        reserved = c.execute("SELECT reserved_tokens FROM worker_model_reservations").fetchone()[0]
    assert reserved <= worker["token_limit"]

        id="wb-local",

        base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8788/v1",
        credential_ref="FORGE_PROVIDER_KEY_LIVE_TEST",
        max_retries=0,
        timeout_seconds=120,
        supports_json_schema=True,
        allow_insecure_loopback=True,
        reasoning_effort="none",
    )

    with httpx.Client(trust_env=False, timeout=15) as client:
        response = client.get(
            config.base_url + "/models", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + key}
        )
        response.raise_for_status()
        model = next(
            item for item in response.json()["data"] if item["id"] == "deepseek-v4.1-flash"
        )

        model[name]
        for name in ("context_window", "context_length", "max_input_tokens")
        if type(model.get(name)) is int and model[name] > 0

        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": False,
        "properties": {
            name: {"type": "string"}
            for name in ("receipt_id", "execution_mode", "state", "candidate_sha256")
        },
        "required": ["receipt_id", "execution_mode", "state", "candidate_sha256"],
    }
    report = {
        "status": "failed",
        "execution_mode": "live",
        "scope": "targeted_receipt_projection_not_autonomous_task_reacceptance",
        "source_run": SOURCE_RUN,
        "source_database_access": "read_only_no_replay",
        "upstream_identity": "unverified_proxy_reported_identity",
        "provider_context_window": window,
        "limits": {"calls": 2, "tokens": 10000, "gateway_retries": 0},
        "observations": [],
    }

                provider_id=config.id,
                model_id=model["id"],

                max_output_tokens=256,

                model_capabilities={"json_schema": True},

                ],

                    "json_schema": {"name": "observed_receipt", "strict": True, "schema": schema},
                },
                budget_context=ModelCallContext(
                    "visibility_" + str(index), "receipt_visibility_probe", store.workspace.id
                ),
            )
            reply = await gateway.generate(request)
            try:
                actual = json.loads(reply.text)
            except ValueError:
                actual = None
            expected = {
                **projection["core_receipt"],
                "candidate_sha256": json.loads(projection["manifest_json"])["candidate.py"],
            }
            expected.pop("intent_id", None)
            report["observations"].append(
                {
                    "original_receipt_id": original["receipt_id"],
                    "projection_sha256": digest(projection),
                    "response_sha256": hashlib.sha256(reply.text.encode()).hexdigest(),
                    "passed": actual == expected,
                    "usage": reply.usage,
                    "finish_reason": reply.finish_reason,
                }
            )

    try:
        asyncio.run(execute())
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - never publish remote text or credentials.
        report["failure_type"] = type(exc).__name__
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(store.path)) as connection:
        connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        report["attempts"] = [
            dict(row)
            for row in connection.execute(
                "SELECT purpose,state,input_charged,output_charged FROM model_budget_attempts ORDER BY rowid"
            )
        ]
    report["status"] = (
        "passed"
        if len(report["observations"]) == 2
        and all(item["passed"] for item in report["observations"])
        and all(item["state"] == "settled" for item in report["attempts"])
        else "failed"
    )
    output = REPO / "docs" / "audit" / "superagent" / (stamp + "-receipt-visibility.json")
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {"status": report["status"], "report": str(output), "calls": len(report["attempts"])}
        )
    )
    return report

def reassign_expert(service, event_id):
    """Admit one settled, source-bound expert handoff through existing contracts.

    This replaces an unfinished Worker. It does not pretend to add a child team,
    rerun completed nodes, refund costs, or replay an unknown call.
    """
    from .domain import ForgeEvent, now_iso
    from .superagent_delegation import DelegationAuthority, _active
    from .team_composition import PRESET_ROLES, CompositionLimits, RoleSpec, TeamCompositionService
    from .worker_recovery import unresolved_calls

    store = service.store
    with store.connection() as c:
        event = c.execute("SELECT * FROM events WHERE id=?", (event_id,)).fetchone()
        if event is None or event["event_type"] not in {
            "worker.help_requested",
            "worker.blocked",
            "worker.failed",
        }:
            raise DomainError("Expert reassignment requires an original Worker event")
        payload = json.loads(event["payload"])
        run = c.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_runs WHERE id=?", (payload.get("run_id"),)).fetchone()
        quest = c.execute("SELECT * FROM quests WHERE id=?", (event["quest_id"],)).fetchone()
        if (
            run is None
            or quest is None
            or run["quest_id"] != quest["id"]
            or run["worker_id"] != event["worker_id"]
            or run["state"] not in {"blocked", "failed"}
            or run["plan_revision"] != quest["plan_revision"]
            or payload.get("plan_id") != run["plan_id"]
            or payload.get("task_node_key") != run["node_key"]
            or quest["status"] not in {"approved", "queued", "running"}
        ):
            raise DomainError("Expert event no longer owns the current stopped Worker")
        mandate = c.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM delegation_mandates WHERE quest_id=?", (quest["id"],)
        ).fetchone()
        if mandate is None:
            raise DomainError("Expert reassignment requires a host mandate")
        _, policy = _active(c, mandate["id"], quest["id"])
        if policy.get("max_help_depth", 0) < 1:
            raise DomainError("Historical mandate does not grant expert recovery")
        if c.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE quest_id=? AND event_type='superagent.expert_reassigned' "
            "AND json_extract(payload,'$.source_event_id')=?",
            (quest["id"], event_id),
        ).fetchone():
            return False
        if (
            unresolved_calls(c, run["id"])
            or c.execute(
                "SELECT 1 FROM worker_model_reservations WHERE run_id=? AND state='reserved'",
                (run["id"],),
            ).fetchone()
            or c.execute(
                "SELECT 1 FROM model_budget_attempts WHERE worker_run_id=? "
                "AND state IN ('reserved','unknown')",
                (run["id"],),
            ).fetchone()
        ):
            raise DomainError("Unsettled Worker calls block expert reassignment")
        if c.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM worker_runs WHERE quest_id=? AND id<>? "
            "AND state IN ('queued','running','paused','blocked','review_pending')",
            (quest["id"], run["id"]),
        ).fetchone():
            raise DomainError("Other active Workers must settle before expert reassignment")
        old = c.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM team_proposals WHERE quest_id=? AND proposal_digest=? AND status='approved'",
            (quest["id"], run["team_digest"]),
        ).fetchone()
        if old is None:
            raise DomainError("Original expert team is no longer approved")
        body = json.loads(old["body_json"])
        allocated = c.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*),COALESCE(SUM(token_limit),0),COALESCE(SUM(tool_limit),0) FROM worker_runs WHERE quest_id=?",
            (quest["id"],),
        ).fetchone()
        unfinished = {
            row["node_key"]
            for row in c.execute(
                "SELECT node_key FROM task_nodes WHERE plan_id=? AND status<>'succeeded'",
                (run["plan_id"],),
            )
        }
        remaining_tools = policy["max_tools"] - allocated[2]
        if allocated[0] + len(unfinished) > policy["max_workers"] or remaining_tools < len(
            unfinished
        ):
            raise DomainError("Expert recovery budget is exhausted")
        is_help = event["event_type"] == "worker.help_requested"
        if is_help:
            role = payload.get("requested_role")
            reason = payload.get("reason")
            if role not in PRESET_ROLES or not isinstance(reason, str) or not reason.strip():
                raise DomainError("Expert request has no bounded registered role")
            source_call = payload.get("model_call_id")
            matched = False
            for message in c.execute(
                "SELECT message_json FROM worker_messages WHERE run_id=? AND role='assistant'",
                (run["id"],),
            ):
                for call in json.loads(message[0]).get("tool_calls", []):
                    function = call.get("function", {})
                    if (

                        and function.get("name") == "worker_request_help"
                        and json.loads(function.get("arguments", "{}"))
                        == {"role": role, "reason": reason}
                    ):
                        matched = True
            if not source_call or not payload.get("budget_call_id") or not matched:
                raise DomainError("Expert request lacks its actual model tool transcript")
            excluded = set()
        else:
            if payload.get("reason_code") not in {"model_error", "provider_unavailable"}:
                raise DomainError("Only a settled Provider failure may request model replacement")
            from .model_performance import model_health_snapshot

            health = model_health_snapshot(
                c, run["provider_id"], run["model_id"], mode=run["execution_mode"]
            )
            if health["recommendation"] == "blocked_unknown":

            role = None

            excluded = {(run["provider_id"], run["model_id"])}
        profiles = store.list_models()
        roles = []
        for original in body["roles"]:
            if original["task_node_key"] not in unfinished:

            data = deepcopy(original)

                data["id"] = role + "_replacement"
                data["dynamic"] = True
                data["required_capabilities"] = {
                    name: 0.0
                    for name in PRESET_ROLES[role]
                    if any(name in profile.capability_measurements for profile in profiles)
                }
                data["responsibility"] = (
                    "Provide the requested expertise for the original unfinished objective. "

                )
            data["max_tool_calls"] = min(16, remaining_tools // len(unfinished))

            roles.append(RoleSpec.model_validate(data))
        limits = CompositionLimits.model_validate(
            {
                **body["limits"],
                "allowed_tools": sorted({tool for item in roles for tool in item.tools}),
            }
        )
        authority = DelegationAuthority(mandate["id"])
        current_version = quest["version"]
        source_run_id, quest_id, revision = run["id"], quest["id"], run["plan_revision"]
    teams = TeamCompositionService(
        store,
        engine=_EligibleReplacementModels(service.teams.engine, excluded),
        operator_max_concurrency=service.teams.operator_max_concurrency,
        capacity_providers=service.teams.capacity_providers,
        budget_ledger=service.teams.budget_ledger,
        composer_capacity_measurer=service.teams.composer_capacity_measurer,
    )
    proposal = teams.propose_reassignment(
        quest_id,
        source_run_id,
        json.dumps({"source_event_id": event_id, "reason": reason[:1000]}, ensure_ascii=False),
        roles,
        limits,
        strategy="complementarity",

    teams.approve(

        proposal["proposal_digest"],
        expected_version=current_version,
        actor=authority.actor,

    )
    with store.unit_of_work() as work:
        work.append_event(

                event_type="superagent.expert_reassigned",
                quest_id=quest_id,

                    "proposal_digest": proposal["proposal_digest"],
                    "kind": "expert" if is_help else "model",
                    "at": now_iso(),
                },
            )
        )
    return True


def recover_expert_requests(service):
    with service.store.connection() as c:
        events = c.execute(
            "SELECT e.id FROM events e JOIN delegation_mandates m ON m.quest_id=e.quest_id "
            "WHERE m.state='active' AND e.event_type IN ('worker.help_requested','worker.blocked','worker.failed') "
            "ORDER BY e.seq DESC LIMIT 32"
        ).fetchall()
    recovered = 0
    for event in events:
        try:
            with service.store.connection() as c:
                payload = json.loads(
                    c.execute("SELECT payload FROM events WHERE id=?", (event["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
                )
            if payload.get("experts") is not None:
                recovered += bool(expand_experts(service, event["id"]))
            else:
                recovered += bool(reassign_expert(service, event["id"]))
        except (DomainError, ValueError, KeyError):
            # Durable source and last successful phase remain. No model call or
            # external effect is repeated; regular Router handling still sees it.
            continue
    return recovered

            "SELECT e.id FROM events e JOIN delegation_mandates m ON m.quest_id=e.quest_id "
            "WHERE m.state='active' AND e.event_type IN ('worker.help_requested','worker.blocked','worker.failed') "
            "ORDER BY e.seq DESC LIMIT 32"
        ).fetchall()
    recovered = 0
    for event in events:
        try:
            with service.store.connection() as c:
                payload = json.loads(
                    c.execute("SELECT payload FROM events WHERE id=?", (event["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
                )
            if payload.get("experts") is not None:
                recovered += bool(expand_experts(service, event["id"]))
            else:

            # external effect is repeated; regular Router handling still sees it.
            continue

                "SELECT * FROM worker_runs WHERE id=?", (run_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            # Failure is safe after expiry, but an old generation must never change

class LiveCore:
    def __init__(
        self, workspace, *, provider_env, token_limit, concurrency, log=None, extra_env=None
    ):
        if token_limit is not None and (type(token_limit) is not int or token_limit < 1):
            raise ValueError("token_limit must be a positive integer or None")
        self.workspace = Path(workspace)
        self.workspace.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.port = free_port()
        self.secret = REDACTED
        self.base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}"
        self.session = None
        self.bearer = None
        self.process = None
        self.provider_env = provider_env
        self.token_limit = token_limit
        self.concurrency = concurrency
        self.log_path = log or self.workspace / "core.log"
        self.extra_env = extra_env or {}
        self.stdout = None

    def env(self):
        raw = bytes.fromhex(self.secret)
        assert len(raw) == 32
        values = {
            "FORGE_WORKSPACE_ROOT": str(self.workspace),
            "FORGE_DB_PATH": "data/forge.sqlite3",
            "FORGE_HOST": "127.0.0.1",
            "FORGE_PORT": str(self.port),
            "FORGE_CORE_SECRET": self.secret,
            "FORGE_ROUTER_MODEL_ID": MODEL_ID,
            "FORGE_ROUTER_CONTEXT_LIMIT": "65536",
            "FORGE_ROUTER_OUTPUT_RESERVE": "4096",
            "FORGE_WORKER_LEASE_SECONDS": "150",
            "FORGE_REVIEW_MAX_ROUNDS": "3",
            "FORGE_ENFORCE_TOKEN_BUDGETS": "false" if self.token_limit is None else "true",
            "FORGE_MODEL_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT": str(self.concurrency),
            "PYTHONIOENCODING": "utf-8",
            "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
        }
        if self.token_limit is not None:
            values["FORGE_MODEL_TOKEN_LIMIT"] = str(self.token_limit)
        values.update(self.provider_env)
        values.update(self.extra_env)
        expected_policy = "false" if self.token_limit is None else "true"
        if values.get("FORGE_ENFORCE_TOKEN_BUDGETS") != expected_policy:
            raise ValueError("Token budget policy conflicts with token_limit")
        if self.token_limit is None:
            if "FORGE_MODEL_TOKEN_LIMIT" in values:
                raise ValueError("Disabled token budgets must omit FORGE_MODEL_TOKEN_LIMIT")
        else:
            try:
                configured_limit = int(values["FORGE_MODEL_TOKEN_LIMIT"])
            except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
                raise ValueError("Invalid model token limit") from exc
            if configured_limit < 1 or configured_limit > self.token_limit:
                raise ValueError("Model token limit must stay within the harness limit")
        base = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("FORGE_")}
        base.update(values)
        return base

    def start(self, timeout=120):
        # Kept open for the child lifetime and closed by stop(), including failures.
        self.stdout = open(self.log_path, "ab")  # noqa: SIM115
        env = self.env()
        creation = 0
        if os.name == "nt":
            creation = subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW
        self.process = subprocess.Popen(
            [str(PYTHON), "-m", "forge_api", "--workspace-root", str(self.workspace)],
            cwd=str(BACKEND),
            env=env,
            stdout=self.stdout,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            creationflags=creation,
        )
        deadline = time.time() + timeout
        while time.time() < deadline:
            if self.process.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError("Core exited during startup")
            try:
                response = httpx.get(self.base_url + "/health", timeout=2, trust_env=False)
                if response.status_code == 200:
                    self.session = response.json()["session"]
                    raw = bytes.fromhex(self.secret)
                    self.bearer = hmac.new(raw, self.session.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
                    return self
            except (httpx.TransportError, httpx.TimeoutException):
                pass
            time.sleep(0.25)
        raise RuntimeError("Core did not become healthy")

    def client(self, timeout=240):
        return httpx.Client(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + self.bearer},
            timeout=httpx.Timeout(connect=5, read=timeout, write=10, pool=5),
            trust_env=False,
            follow_redirects=False,
        )

    def call(self, method, path, payload=None, timeout=240):
        with self.client(timeout=timeout) as client:
            response = client.request(method, path, json=payload)
        try:
            body = response.json()
        except ValueError:
            body = {"raw": response.text[:400]}
        return {"status": response.status_code, "body": body}

    def stop(self, *, graceful=True):
        if self.process is None:
            return
        if self.process.poll() is None:
            if graceful:
                self.process.terminate()
            else:
                self.process.kill()
            try:
                self.process.wait(timeout=30)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                self.process.kill()
                self.process.wait(timeout=15)
        if self.stdout:
            self.stdout.close()
            self.stdout = None

    def tail_log(self, limit=4000):
        if not self.log_path.exists():
            return ""
        data = self.log_path.read_bytes()[-limit:]
        return data.decode("utf-8", "replace")

                except ValueError:
                    self.send_error(400)
                    return
                if not 0 <= size <= 4 * 1024 * 1024:
                    self.send_error(413)
                    return
                body = self.rfile.read(size)
                if owner.select_fault(body, self.path) is not None:
                    payload = b'{"error":{"code":"intentional_test_503"}}'
                    self.send_response(503)
                    self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                    self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
                    self.end_headers()
                    self.wfile.write(payload)
                    return
                try:
                    # Only the authenticated request's existing credential is
                    # forwarded to the named local upstream; no key is stored.
                    headers = {name: self.headers[name] for name in ("Authorization", "Content-Type")
                               if name in self.headers}
                    with httpx.Client(trust_env=False, timeout=60, follow_redirects=False) as client:
                        response = client.request(
                            self.command, owner.upstream + self.path.removeprefix("/v1"),
                            headers=headers, content=body,
                        )
                    with owner._lock:
                        owner.forwarded += 1
                    self.send_response(response.status_code)
                    self.send_header("Content-Type", response.headers.get("content-type", "application/json"))
                    self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(response.content)))
                    self.end_headers()
                    self.wfile.write(response.content)
                except (httpx.HTTPError, OSError) as exc:
                    with owner._lock:
                        owner.forward_errors.append(type(exc).__name__)
                    # An interrupted upstream request has an unknown outcome.
                    # Close the client connection, preserving Gateway's unknown
                    # reservation; never fabricate an HTTP rejection or usage.
                    self.close_connection = True

            do_GET = handle_request
            do_POST = handle_request

        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        self.server.daemon_threads = True
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()
        self.base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_port}/v1"
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *_args):
        if self.server:
            self.server.shutdown()
            self.server.server_close()
        if self.thread:
            self.thread.join(timeout=2)


def registry_profiles(declared):
    profiles = []
    for index, model_id in enumerate((PRIMARY, ALTERNATIVE)):
        model = next((item for item in declared if item.get("id") == model_id), None)
        if model is None:
            raise ValueError("Both actual upstream model identities are required")
        windows = [model[name] for name in ("context_window", "context_length", "max_input_tokens")
                   if type(model.get(name)) is int and model[name] > 0]
        if not windows:
            raise ValueError("Actual model context declarations are required")
        profile = deepcopy(live_core.MODEL_PROFILE)
        profile.update(id=model_id, model_id=model_id, display_name=model_id,
                       context_window=min(windows), max_output_tokens=min(
                           8192, model.get("max_output_tokens", 8192)))
        for measurement in profile["capability_measurements"].values():
            measurement.update(value=max(0, measurement["value"] - index * 10),
                               source="operator_probe_eligibility_prior_unmeasured", n_samples=None)
        profile["provenance"] = {
            "context_source": "provider_declared_not_measured",
            "capability_source": "operator_probe_eligibility_prior_unmeasured",
            "selection_condition": "primary_prior_above_alternative_for_fault_probe_only",
            "protocol_source": "operator_probe_eligibility_not_verified_tool_success",
        }
        profiles.append(profile)
    return profiles


def failover_observations(database, workspace, quest_id, injected, initial_router):
    state = snapshot(database)
    runs = read_rows(database, "SELECT id,quest_id,model_id,execution_mode,state FROM worker_runs")
    attempts = read_rows(database, "SELECT attempt_id,purpose,model_id,state,input_charged,output_charged "
                         "FROM model_budget_attempts ORDER BY rowid")
    local_reserved = read_rows(database, "SELECT call_id FROM worker_model_reservations WHERE state='reserved'")
    replacements = [run for run in runs if run["quest_id"] == quest_id
                    and run["id"] != injected.get("worker_run_id") and run["model_id"] == ALTERNATIVE]
    events = [(event, json.loads(event["payload"])) for event in state["events"]]
    reassigned = any(event["event_type"] == "superagent.expert_reassigned"
                     and payload.get("source_run_id") == injected.get("worker_run_id")
                     and payload.get("kind") == "model" for event, payload in events)
    completed = any(quest["id"] == quest_id and quest["status"] == "completed" for quest in state["quests"])
    passed = any(event["event_type"] == "review.result" and payload.get("verdict") == "PASS"
                 and payload.get("run_id") in {run["id"] for run in replacements}
                 for event, payload in events)
    path = workspace / "work" / quest_id / "recovered.txt"
    correct_bytes = path.is_file() and path.read_bytes() == (MARKER + "\n").encode()
    digest = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if path.is_file() else None
    receipt_ok = any(
        write["run_id"] in {run["id"] for run in replacements}
        and write["tool_name"] in {"file_write", "file_revise"}
        and Path(write["resource_scope"]).resolve() == path.resolve()
        and json.loads(write["result_json"]).get("sha256") == digest
        and any(read["run_id"] == write["run_id"] and read["tool_name"] == "file_read"
                and read["resource_scope"] == write["resource_scope"]
                and json.loads(read["result_json"]).get("sha256") == digest
                for read in state["receipts"])
        for write in state["receipts"]
    )
    accounted = all(attempt["state"] == "settled" or (
        attempt["attempt_id"] == injected.get("attempt_id") and attempt["state"] == "rejected"
    ) for attempt in attempts) and not local_reserved
    return {
        "checks": {
            "native_model_reassignment": reassigned,
            "alternative_model_completed_real_worker": bool(replacements) and all(
                run["state"] == "succeeded" and run["execution_mode"] == "live" for run in replacements),
            "real_artifact_matches_exact_acceptance": correct_bytes,
            "replacement_source_bound_write_and_read_receipts": receipt_ok,
            "independent_reviewer_pass": passed,
            "quest_completed": completed,
            "same_original_router_delivered_result": state["router"] == initial_router
                and quest_id in notices_for_tasks(state),
            "all_noninjected_attempts_settled": accounted,
        },
        "attempts": attempts,
        "worker_models": [{key: run[key] for key in ("id", "model_id", "state", "execution_mode")} for run in runs],
        "artifact_sha256": digest,
        "local_reserved_count": len(local_reserved),
    }


def run(*, key):
    identifier = datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ") + "-failover-" + secrets.token_hex(3)
    workspace = REPO / ".local" / "superagent" / identifier
    workspace.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    source = workspace / "inputs/value.txt"
    source.parent.mkdir()
    source.write_text(MARKER + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    source_hash = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    database = workspace / "data/forge.sqlite3"
    report = {"run_id": identifier, "status": "failed", "execution_mode": "live",
              "experiment": "intentional_single_http_503_model_replacement_not_natural_failure",
              "upstream_identity": "unverified_proxy_reported_identity",
              "limits": {"http_attempts": CALL_LIMIT, "tokens": TOKEN_LIMIT, "seconds": WALL_LIMIT, "retries": 0},
              "source_sha256": source_digest(), "checks": {},
              "comparison_scope": "one_failover_condition_no_claim_of_optimal_model_or_team"}
    core = None
    executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1)
    future = None
    began = time.monotonic()
    with OneShotFaultProxy(database) as proxy:
        try:
            with httpx.Client(trust_env=False, timeout=15, follow_redirects=False) as client:
                discovery = client.get(proxy.base_url + "/models", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + key})
                discovery.raise_for_status()
                profiles = registry_profiles(discovery.json()["data"])
            env = live_core.provider_env_from_key(key)
            env.update(FORGE_PROVIDER_BASE_URL=proxy.base_url, FORGE_MODEL_CALL_LIMIT=str(CALL_LIMIT),
                       FORGE_PROVIDER_MAX_RETRIES="0", FORGE_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS="60",
                       FORGE_ROUTER_CONTEXT_LIMIT=str(profiles[0]["context_window"]))
            core = live_core.LiveCore(workspace, provider_env=env, token_limit=TOKEN_LIMIT, concurrency=1)
            core.start(timeout=45)
            for profile in profiles:
                result = core.call("POST", "/api/models", profile, timeout=15)
                if result["status"] != 200:
                    raise ValueError("Registry eligibility registration failed")
            initial_router = snapshot(database)["router"]
            prompt = (f'Work in local project "{workspace}". Use one coding Worker (single strategy). '
                      "Read inputs/value.txt with a governed tool; write its exact bytes to "
                      "work/<your actual quest_id>/recovered.txt and read the written file back. "
                      "Do not modify inputs. Report the real paths and receipts in the original Router. "
                      "Acceptance is exact byte preservation, source-bound write/read receipts and independent review. "
                      "No Python, shell, network or additional expertise is required.")
            future = executor.submit(core.call, "POST", "/api/conversation/message",
                                     {"content": prompt, "request_id": identifier}, timeout=75)
            quest_id = None
            while time.monotonic() - began < WALL_LIMIT:
                if core.process.poll() is not None:
                    raise ValueError("Core exited")
                if future.done():
                    response = future.result()
                    if response["status"] != 200 or response["body"].get("intent") != "create_quest":
                        raise ValueError("Router did not create the task")
                    quest_id = response["body"].get("quest_id")
                attempts = read_rows(database, "SELECT state FROM model_budget_attempts")
                if any(row["state"] == "unknown" for row in attempts):
                    raise ValueError("Unknown model outcome preserved without replay")
                if quest_id and proxy.injections:
                    report.update(failover_observations(database, workspace, quest_id,
                                                       proxy.injections[0], initial_router))
                    if all(report["checks"].values()):
                        break
                if len(attempts) >= CALL_LIMIT and not any(row["state"] == "reserved" for row in attempts):
                    raise ValueError("HTTP attempt ceiling reached")
                time.sleep(0.25)
            else:
                raise TimeoutError("Bounded failover observation expired")
            report["checks"]["input_unchanged"] = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == source_hash
            report["checks"]["exactly_one_known_fault"] = len(proxy.injections) == 1
            report["checks"]["no_forwarding_transport_failures"] = not proxy.forward_errors
            report["status"] = "passed" if all(report["checks"].values()) else "failed"
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - do not publish exception/provider text.
            report["failure_type"] = type(exc).__name__
        finally:
            if future:
                future.cancel()
            if core:
                core.stop()
            executor.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True)
            report["injected_faults"] = list(proxy.injections)
            report["forwarded_http_requests_including_discovery"] = proxy.forwarded
            report["forwarding_error_types"] = list(proxy.forward_errors)
    report["elapsed_seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - began, 3)
    output = REPO / "docs/audit/superagent" / (identifier + ".json")
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return report, output


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--credential-env", default="FORGE_PROVIDER_KEY_LIVE_TEST")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    credential = os.environ.get(args.credential_env)
    if not credential:
        raise SystemExit("The named process credential is required; no credential file is read")
    report, output = run(key=credential)
    print(json.dumps({"status": report["status"], "report": str(output)}))
    return 0 if report["status"] == "passed" else 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Programmatic proxy/accounting checks; no Provider model is called."""

import importlib.util
import json
import sqlite3
import sys
import threading
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

import httpx
import pytest

SCRIPTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts"
sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPTS))
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("failover_driver", SCRIPTS / "verify_superagent_failover.py")
driver = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(driver)


def ledger(tmp_path, *, purpose="worker", model=driver.PRIMARY, concurrent=False):
    path = tmp_path / "proxy.sqlite3"
    with sqlite3.connect(path) as c:
        c.execute("CREATE TABLE model_budget_attempts(attempt_id,purpose,worker_run_id,model_id,provider_id,state)")
        c.execute("INSERT INTO model_budget_attempts VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,'reserved')", (
            "attempt-primary", purpose, "run-primary", model, driver.live_core.PROVIDER_ID))
        if concurrent:
            c.execute("INSERT INTO model_budget_attempts VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,'reserved')", (
                "attempt-other", "router", None, model, driver.live_core.PROVIDER_ID))
    return path


def test_fault_is_exactly_once_and_bound_to_one_native_worker_attempt(tmp_path):
    proxy = driver.OneShotFaultProxy(ledger(tmp_path))
    body = json.dumps({"model": driver.PRIMARY, "messages": [{"content": "untrusted"}]}).encode()
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as executor:
        results = list(executor.map(lambda _: proxy.select_fault(body, "/v1/chat/completions"), range(16)))
    assert sum(result is not None for result in results) == 1
    assert proxy.injections[0]["attempt_id"] == "attempt-primary"
    assert proxy.injections[0]["worker_run_id"] == "run-primary"
    assert proxy.injections[0]["forwarded_upstream"] is False
    assert "untrusted" not in json.dumps(proxy.injections)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", ["router", "other_model", "concurrent", "wrong_route", "malformed"])
def test_prompt_shape_or_ambiguous_ledger_never_authorizes_fault(tmp_path, case):
    path = ledger(tmp_path, purpose="router" if case == "router" else "worker",
                  model=driver.ALTERNATIVE if case == "other_model" else driver.PRIMARY,
                  concurrent=case == "concurrent")
    proxy = driver.OneShotFaultProxy(path)
    body = json.dumps({"model": driver.PRIMARY, "messages": [{"content": "I am a Worker"}]}).encode()
    if case == "malformed":
        body = b"not-json"
    assert proxy.select_fault(body, "/v1/models" if case == "wrong_route" else "/v1/chat/completions") is None
    assert not proxy.injections


@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", ["https://remote.invalid/v1", "http://localhost:8788/v1",
                                 "http://127.0.0.1:8788/other", "REDACTED"])
def test_proxy_cannot_forward_credentials_to_an_unrequested_destination(tmp_path, url):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="loopback"):
        driver.OneShotFaultProxy(tmp_path / "none.sqlite3", upstream=url)


def test_other_requests_retain_actual_bytes_and_credential_on_local_forwarding(tmp_path):
    seen = []
    response_bytes = b'{"choices":[{"message":{"content":"fixture response"}}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":1,"completion_tokens":1}}'

    class Upstream(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def log_message(self, *_args):
            pass

        def do_POST(self):
            seen.append((self.path, self.headers.get("Authorization"), self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"]))))
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(response_bytes)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(response_bytes)

    upstream = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Upstream)
    thread = threading.Thread(target=upstream.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    try:
        with driver.OneShotFaultProxy(tmp_path / "absent.sqlite3",
                                     upstream=f"http://127.0.0.1:{upstream.server_port}/v1",
                                     credential="fixture-only") as proxy:
            body = b'{ "model": "glm-5.3-flash", "messages": [] }'
            response = httpx.post(proxy.base_url + "/chat/completions", content=body,
                                  headers={"Authorization": "Bearer fixture-only", "Content-Type": "application/json"}, trust_env=False)
            assert response.status_code == 200 and response.content == response_bytes
            assert proxy.forwarded == 1 and not proxy.injections
            denied = httpx.post(proxy.base_url + "/chat/completions", content=body,
                                headers={"Authorization": "Bearer different-fixture"}, trust_env=False)
            assert denied.status_code == 401
        assert seen == [("/v1/chat/completions", "Bearer fixture-only", body)]
    finally:
        upstream.shutdown()
        upstream.server_close()
        thread.join(timeout=2)


def test_profiles_are_actual_model_identities_with_unmeasured_priors():
    profiles = driver.registry_profiles([
        {"id": driver.PRIMARY, "context_window": 1000000, "max_output_tokens": 128000},
        {"id": driver.ALTERNATIVE, "context_window": 200000, "max_output_tokens": 16000},
    ])
    assert [profile["model_id"] for profile in profiles] == [driver.PRIMARY, driver.ALTERNATIVE]
    assert [profile["context_window"] for profile in profiles] == [1000000, 200000]
    assert all(profile["max_output_tokens"] == 8192 for profile in profiles)
    assert all(measurement["n_samples"] is None and measurement["source"].endswith("unmeasured")
               for profile in profiles for measurement in profile["capability_measurements"].values())
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Both actual"):
        driver.registry_profiles([{"id": driver.PRIMARY, "context_window": 1000000}])

"""Programmatic Worker failure/reassignment tests with explicit Mock models."""

import asyncio
import json

import httpx
import pytest
from test_superagent_delegation import delegated as delegated  # noqa: PLC0414
from test_worker_intelligence_phase2 import delivery

from forge_core.domain import DomainError
from forge_core.model_call_budget import ModelCallBudgetLedger
from forge_core.model_performance import model_health_snapshot
from forge_core.provider_pool import PriceBound, ProviderPool
from forge_core.providers import ProviderConfig, ProviderError, ProviderGateway
from forge_core.superagent_swarm import reassign_expert
from forge_core.tool_engine import ToolEngine
from forge_core.worker_model_usage import completed_gateway_rejection_proof
from forge_core.worker_runtime import WorkerManager


class SettledFailure:
    execution_mode = "mock"

    def __init__(self):
        self.requests = []

    async def generate(self, request):
        self.requests.append(request)
        # The Mock adapter's explicit usage contract is settled by actual Core
        # accounting. This is an injected protocol failure, never live evidence.
        raise ProviderError("truncated", usage={"input_tokens": 25, "output_tokens": 15})


def failed_worker(delegated):
    store, quest_id, mandate, graph, teams, service = delegated
    assert service.prepare(quest_id)
    original_profile = store.list_models()[0]
    store.save_model(original_profile.model_copy(update={"id": "backup", "model_id": "backup-model"}))
    with store.connection() as connection:
        team = connection.execute("SELECT proposal_digest FROM team_proposals").fetchone()[0]
    model = SettledFailure()
    manager = WorkerManager(
        store,
        ProviderPool({"mock-provider": model}),
        ToolEngine(store),
        team_authority=teams,
        max_repairs=0,
    )
    plan = graph.get(quest_id)
    run = manager.start(quest_id, plan["id"], "task", team_digest=team, member_index=0)
    assert asyncio.run(manager.run(run["id"]))["state"] == "blocked"
    with store.connection() as connection:
        event = connection.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM events WHERE event_type='worker.blocked' AND worker_id=? ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1",
            (run["worker_id"],),
        ).fetchone()
        assert json.loads(event["payload"])["reason_code"] == "model_error"
        assert connection.execute("SELECT state FROM worker_model_reservations").fetchone()[0] == "settled"
    return store, quest_id, mandate, service, manager, run, event, model


def snapshot(store, run_id):
    with store.connection() as connection:
        return {
            "run": dict(connection.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_runs WHERE id=?", (run_id,)).fetchone()),
            "ledgers": [dict(row) for row in connection.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_budget_ledger ORDER BY scope,scope_id")],
            "reservations": [dict(row) for row in connection.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_model_reservations ORDER BY call_id")],
            "teams": connection.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_proposals").fetchone()[0],
        }


def test_settled_provider_failure_selects_different_model_without_refunding_original_allocation(delegated):
    store, quest_id, _mandate, service, manager, run, event, model = failed_worker(delegated)
    before = snapshot(store, run["id"])
    assert reassign_expert(service, event["id"])
    after = snapshot(store, run["id"])
    assert before["ledgers"] == after["ledgers"]
    assert before["reservations"] == after["reservations"]
    assert after["run"]["token_spent"] == before["run"]["token_spent"] == 40
    assert after["run"]["tool_spent"] == before["run"]["tool_spent"] == 0
    assert after["run"]["state"] == "cancelled" and len(model.requests) == 1
    with store.connection() as connection:
        approved = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM team_proposals WHERE status='approved'").fetchone()
        member = json.loads(approved["body_json"])["members"][0]
        assert member["provider_id"] == "mock-provider" and member["model_id"] == "backup-model"
        replaced = connection.execute("SELECT payload FROM events WHERE event_type='superagent.expert_reassigned'").fetchone()
        assert json.loads(replaced[0])["kind"] == "model"

    )
    assert replacement["state"] == "queued" and replacement["model_id"] == "backup-model"
    with store.connection() as connection:
        assert connection.execute("SELECT SUM(tool_limit) FROM worker_runs").fetchone()[0] <= 64
        assert connection.execute("SELECT SUM(token_limit) FROM worker_runs").fetchone()[0] <= 1_000_000


@pytest.mark.parametrize("unknown", ["gateway", "tool"])
def test_provider_replacement_refuses_unknown_calls_without_changing_state(delegated, unknown):
    store, quest_id, _mandate, service, _manager, run, event, _model = failed_worker(delegated)
    with store.unit_of_work() as work:

    def _begin(self, intent_id, lease_token):
        with self.store.unit_of_work() as work:
            intent = work.connection.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM action_intents WHERE id=?", (intent_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if intent is None:
                raise DomainError("Unknown action intent")
            parameters = json.loads(intent["parameters_json"])
            self._context(
                work,
                intent["quest_id"],
                intent["worker_id"],
                intent["run_id"],
                lease_token,
                intent["tool_name"],
                intent["call_id"],
                parameters,
            )
            if (
                parameter_digest(parameters) != intent["parameter_digest"]
                or self._scope(intent["tool_name"], parameters) != intent["resource_scope"]
            ):
                raise DomainError("Action binding changed")
            if intent["risk"] == "R1":
                grants = work.connection.execute(
                    "SELECT resource_scope FROM task_grants WHERE quest_id=? AND workspace_id=? AND plan_revision=? AND revoked_at IS NULL",
                    (intent["quest_id"], self.store.workspace.id, intent["plan_revision"]),
                ).fetchall()
                if not any(
                    Path(intent["resource_scope"]).is_relative_to(Path(grant["resource_scope"]))
                    for grant in grants
                ):
                    raise DomainError("Workspace grant was revoked")
            if intent["risk"] == "R2":
                approval = work.connection.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM approvals WHERE id=?", (intent["approval_id"],)
                ).fetchone()
                if (
                    approval is None
                    or approval["status"] != "APPROVED"
                    or not approval["consumed_at"]
                    or datetime.fromisoformat(approval["expires_at"]) <= datetime.now(UTC)
                ):
                    raise DomainError("Approval is no longer valid")
            if intent["state"] != "prepared":
                return dict(intent), False
            if intent["tool_name"] == "file_revise":
                self._revision_source(
                    work.connection,
                    intent["run_id"],
                    intent["resource_scope"],
                    parameters,
                    intent_id=intent_id,
                )
            changed = work.connection.execute(
                "UPDATE action_intents SET state='executing',updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND state='prepared'",
                (now_iso(), intent_id),
            )
            return dict(intent), changed.rowcount == 1

    def _allowed_url(self, url):
        try:
            parsed = urlsplit(url)
            host = parsed.hostname
            if (
                parsed.scheme != "https"
                or not host
                or host not in self._network_hosts
                or parsed.username
                or parsed.password
                or parsed.fragment
                or parsed.port not in (None, 443)
            ):
                raise ValueError
        except (ValueError, OSError) as exc:
            raise DomainError("Network target is not allowed") from exc
        return parsed

    @staticmethod
    def _read_revision_target(path):
        if path.is_symlink() or (hasattr(path, "is_junction") and path.is_junction()):
            raise DomainError("Artifact revision target is not a regular file")
        descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0))
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "rb") as stream:
            metadata = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
            if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode) or metadata.st_nlink != 1:
                raise DomainError("Artifact revision target is not a private regular file")
            data = stream.read(_MAX_BYTES + 1)
        if len(data) > _MAX_BYTES:
            raise DomainError("Artifact revision target exceeds size limit")
        return data, (metadata.st_dev, metadata.st_ino, metadata.st_size, metadata.st_mtime_ns)

    def _revision_source(self, connection, run_id, scope, parameters, *, intent_id=None):
        source = verify_file_revision_chain(connection, run_id, parameters["prior_receipt_id"])
        latest = connection.execute(

    def _begin(self, intent_id, lease_token):
        with self.store.unit_of_work() as work:
            intent = work.connection.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM action_intents WHERE id=?", (intent_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if intent is None:
                raise DomainError("Unknown action intent")
            parameters = json.loads(intent["parameters_json"])
            self._context(
                work,
                intent["quest_id"],
                intent["worker_id"],
                intent["run_id"],
                lease_token,
                intent["tool_name"],
                intent["call_id"],
                parameters,
            )
            if (
                parameter_digest(parameters) != intent["parameter_digest"]
                or self._scope(intent["tool_name"], parameters) != intent["resource_scope"]
            ):
                raise DomainError("Action binding changed")
            if intent["risk"] == "R1":
                grants = work.connection.execute(
                    "SELECT resource_scope FROM task_grants WHERE quest_id=? AND workspace_id=? AND plan_revision=? AND revoked_at IS NULL",
                    (intent["quest_id"], self.store.workspace.id, intent["plan_revision"]),
                ).fetchall()
                if not any(
                    Path(intent["resource_scope"]).is_relative_to(Path(grant["resource_scope"]))
                    for grant in grants
                ):
                    raise DomainError("Workspace grant was revoked")
            if intent["risk"] == "R2":
                approval = work.connection.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM approvals WHERE id=?", (intent["approval_id"],)
                ).fetchone()
                if (
                    approval is None
                    or approval["status"] != "APPROVED"
                    or not approval["consumed_at"]
                    or datetime.fromisoformat(approval["expires_at"]) <= datetime.now(UTC)
                ):
                    raise DomainError("Approval is no longer valid")
            if intent["state"] != "prepared":
                return dict(intent), False
            if intent["tool_name"] == "file_revise":
                self._revision_source(
                    work.connection,
                    intent["run_id"],
                    intent["resource_scope"],
                    parameters,
                    intent_id=intent_id,
                )
            changed = work.connection.execute(
                "UPDATE action_intents SET state='executing',updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND state='prepared'",
                (now_iso(), intent_id),
            )
            return dict(intent), changed.rowcount == 1

    def _allowed_url(self, url):
        try:
            parsed = urlsplit(url)
            host = parsed.hostname
            if (
                parsed.scheme != "https"
                or not host
                or host not in self._network_hosts
                or parsed.username
                or parsed.password
                or parsed.fragment
                or parsed.port not in (None, 443)
            ):
                raise ValueError
        except (ValueError, OSError) as exc:
            raise DomainError("Network target is not allowed") from exc
        return parsed

    @staticmethod
    def _read_revision_target(path):
        if path.is_symlink() or (hasattr(path, "is_junction") and path.is_junction()):
            raise DomainError("Artifact revision target is not a regular file")
        descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0))
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "rb") as stream:
            metadata = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
            if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode) or metadata.st_nlink != 1:
                raise DomainError("Artifact revision target is not a private regular file")
            data = stream.read(_MAX_BYTES + 1)
        if len(data) > _MAX_BYTES:
            raise DomainError("Artifact revision target exceeds size limit")
        return data, (metadata.st_dev, metadata.st_ino, metadata.st_size, metadata.st_mtime_ns)

tools.name: exec

tools.description:
Waits on a yielded `exec` cell and returns new output or completion.
- Use `wait` only after `exec` returns `Script running with cell ID ...`.
- `cell_id` identifies the running `exec` cell to resume.
- `yield_time_ms` controls how long to wait for more output before yielding again. Defaults to 10000 ms.
- `max_tokens` limits how much new output this wait call returns. Defaults to 10000 tokens.
- `terminate: true` stops the running cell; false or omitted waits for output.
- `wait` returns only the new output since the last yield, or the final completion or termination result for that cell.
- If the cell is still running, `wait` may yield again with the same `cell_id`.
- If the cell has already finished, `wait` returns the completed result and closes the cell.
tools.name: wait

cell_id.description: Identifier of the running exec cell.

max_tokens.description: Output token budget for this wait call. Defaults to 10000 tokens.

terminate.description: True stops the running exec cell; false or omitted waits for output.

yield_time_ms.description: Wait before yielding more output. Defaults to 10000 ms.

tools.description:
Available model overrides (optional; inherited parent model is preferred):
- `gpt-6.1-sol`: Latest workhorse model for coding and everyday work. Reasoning efforts: low (default), medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra. Service tiers: priority.
- `gpt-6-astra`: Frontier intelligence for the most demanding work. Reasoning efforts: low (default), medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra. Service tiers: priority.
- `gpt-6-sol`: Previous generation workhorse model. Reasoning efforts: low, medium (default), high, xhigh, max, ultra. Service tiers: priority.
- `gpt-6-luna`: Fast and affordable model for easier tasks. Reasoning efforts: low, medium (default), high, xhigh, max. Service tiers: priority.
- `gpt-5.6-sol`: Older generation workhorse model. Reasoning efforts: low (default), medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra. Service tiers: priority.
        Spawns an agent to work on the specified task. If your current task is `/root/task1` and you spawn_agent with task_name "task_3" the agent will have canonical task name `/root/task1/task_3`.
You are then able to refer to this agent as `task_3` or `/root/task1/task_3` interchangeably. However an agent `/root/task2/task_3` would only be able to communicate with this agent via its canonical name `/root/task1/task_3`.
The spawned agent will have the same tools as you and the ability to spawn its own subagents.

It will be able to send you and other running agents messages, and its final answer will be provided to you when it finishes.
The new agent's canonical task name will be provided to it along with the message.

Note that passing `fork_turns="none"` will not pass any surrounding context to the spawned subagent, which may cause the agent to lack the context it needs to complete its task, whereas `fork_turns="all"` will provide the subagent with all surrounding context.

The wait also ends early when new user input is steered into the active turn. Does not return the content; returns either a summary of which agents have updates (if any), an interruption summary for steered input, or a timeout summary if no activity arrives before the deadline.

tools.description: UI automation through cua_repl using the initialized cua API.
tools.name: mcp__cua_repl

tools.description:
Control native apps or browsers on the user’s computer by reading or operating UI. Prefer purpose-built skills, connectors, APIs, or CLIs when available.

On the first invocation of `cua_repl`, or after resetting it, execute exactly one of the API calls shown below, optionally assigning its result to a variable. Do not add other API calls, waits, or snapshots to that invocation.
The tool result will include documentation and, when creating or selecting a tab or selecting an app, its initial UI state. Selecting a browser does not open a tab. Read that result before continuing.
Use only APIs described in the tool instructions or returned documentation.

When you need an inventory of available apps, browsers, and tabs, get a snapshot of all enabled surfaces. Otherwise, use the relevant entry point below:

```javascript
await cua.getState();
```

Use the first matching browser control option from the user's request:

For a tab @-mention (`mention=tab-v1`):
Pass the complete `plugin://...` URL to get the referenced tab.

```javascript
let tab = await cua.getTab({ mention: tabMentionUrl });
```

For an existing tab identified by URL in browser context (including the current IAB tab):

```javascript
let tab = await cua.getTab({ url }, { browser: browserId });
```

Known tab ID (`tabId` or `providerTabId`) and browser (name or browser @-mention):

```javascript
let tab = await cua.getTab(tabId, { browser: browserId });
```

To open a URL in the in-app browser (`@Browser`):

```javascript
let tab = await cua.createBrowserTab("iab", url, { visible: boolean });
```

To open a URL in another named browser: pass its name directly; do not call `getBrowser` first.

```javascript
let tab = await cua.createBrowserTab(browserName, url, browserOptions);
```

Known URL, only when the user has not specified a browser by name or @-mention:

```javascript
let browser = await cua.getBrowser({ url });
```

Browser IDs and options:

- `"mcpapps"`: use `cua.getBrowser({ id: "mcpapps" })` for existing full-screen MCP Apps in the task’s side panel.
- `"iab"` (in-app browser): in `createBrowserTab`, use `visible: true` to show the browser; `false` to keep it hidden.
- `"dot"` (Dot): use only when present in browser inventory. It accesses tabs on Dot's active main thread. `cua.getTab(tabId, { browser: "dot" })` selects an existing tab. `cua.createBrowserTab("dot", url, { visible: boolean })` creates one with the same visibility options as `"iab"`.
- `"chrome"` (@Chrome), `"edge"` (@Edge): pass a short, emoji-prefixed `sessionName` (e.g. `"🔎 Task"`) to `createBrowserTab` when starting a task.

On Windows, choose the requested window by app and title from the inventory. Pass the selected window's ID as returned.

```javascript
let app = await cua.getApp({ windowId: selected.id });
```

To add other content to the tool result, use `nodeRepl.write(value)` for text or other values and `await nodeRepl.emitImage(image)` for images. The APIs listed above already display their documentation or UI state; do not wrap their results in `write` or `emitImage`.

If your context begins with a summary of an existing computer use task, call `await cua.rewriteDocumentation()` before continuing the computer use task to ensure you have a complete view of the necessary documentation.

Several `cua_repl.js` calls may work toward the same goal. As soon as you observe the final outcome of the CUA part of the task, make your next tool call `cua_repl.js` with only `completion_summary`, exactly once. Do this before using another tool for the next part of the user’s request or sending your reply, even if the overall request continues. If you hand control to the user, wait to summarize until the handoff has ended and you’ve observed the final outcome of the CUA part of the task. This tool is part of plugin `unified-computer-use`.

content.text:
我们需要纠正 FORGE 的架构方向。你自己设定一个目标，不断推进。

本项目真正的目标是：**自主研发一套通用版 DeepSeek Super-agent，而不是普通 Agent、Agent 管理平台或简单的 Multi-Agent 框架。**

请将 DeepSeek Harness 团队的《Exploring Super-agent Design: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System》作为核心架构依据，并深入研究官方原型：

[https://github.com/DeepSeek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/DeepSeek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype)

同时研究：

- [https://github.com/openai/codex](https://github.com/openai/codex)
- [https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code)

Codex 和 Claude Code 主要用于研究底层 Harness、工具执行、上下文压缩和权限设计；**DeepSeek Super-agent 才是 FORGE 的总体架构目标。**

### 必须实现的核心架构

1. Persistent Router：一个长期存在的主 Session，负责所有用户交互、全局记忆和任务协调。
2. Isolated Workers：每项独立任务使用独立 Worker Session 和执行环境，Worker 不直接与用户交互。
3. Event-driven Triggers：支持用户消息、定时任务、文件变化、任务结果及外部事件；实现 Fast Path 和 Slow Path 两级过滤。
4. Thread Subscription & Pass-through：同一任务后续事件直接路由到对应 Worker，避免所有事件都经过 Router 推理。
5. Inline & Spill：合理控制上下文，把必要信息内联，完整内容保留在外部存储并按需读取。
6. Chain of Recall：通过对象引用关系恢复历史任务、项目状态、决策和执行记录。
7. Persistent State：Conversation、Router、Worker、Quest 和 Event 均可持久化与恢复。
8. Watchdog：监控 Router、Worker、Dispatcher 和执行环境，处理异常退出、超时及恢复。

### FORGE 自己的扩展

- 通用 Workspace 自动识别和关联，不局限于 GitHub。
- Model Intelligence Registry：管理模型的数学、编程、设计、研究、推理、速度和成本属性。
- Adaptive Team Composition：Router 根据任务动态选择模型、角色和 Worker 数量。
- 本地优先，支持终端、文件、浏览器、Git、MCP 和 GPU 等工具。
- 统一对话入口，所有 Worker 结果由 Router 汇总。

### 重构要求

先深入阅读 DeepSeek 论文、官方原型的文档和源码，逐模块对比当前 FORGE。

重点审查现有 Router、Worker Runtime、Dispatcher、Event、Context、Memory 和 Watchdog 实现。

不要推倒重写，也不要为了架构图增加无意义的 Manager。保留已经可靠的数据库事务、CAS、Outbox、权限和证据机制。

前端目前效果不错，保持现有前端不变，主要重构后端。

允许连续实施，不必每个小阶段等待确认。每次重构都必须有测试和真实 Provider 验证。

### 最终验收

用户只与一个长期存在的 FORGE 对话。

FORGE 能够持续接收事件、理解任务、自动创建和管理多个隐藏 Worker、订阅后续事件、并行执行、主动恢复失败，并通过 Chain of Recall 保持跨项目连续性。

用户不需要管理 Session，不需要手动分配 Agent，也不需要频繁重新解释任务。

请先完成架构差异审计，再制定最小改动的重构计划，然后直接实施。

**不要再把 FORGE 做成 Quest/DAG/Approval 管理平台。它们只是 Super-agent 的内部基础设施。核心产品是一个持续运行、主动工作、能够组织多个 Worker 的 Super-agent。**
